Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the initial step by incorrectly stating as a "Known starting point" that "J.A.R.V.I.S. voice actor is Paul Bettany." While this fact is true, the Planner failed to verify this premise through the available tools (WebSurfer) before proceeding. Instead of treating the identification of the voice actor as the first step to be verified, the Planner assumed it as prior knowledge. This premature assumption led to a flawed workflow where the subsequent steps focused entirely on verifying the spouse of a person whose identity was never actually confirmed by the agents. The correct approach would have been to first instruct the WebSurfer to search "Who voices J.A.R.V.I.S. in Iron Man?" to establish the fact, and only then proceed to find the spouse. By skipping this verification, the Planner introduced a logical gap where the core premise of the task was taken for granted rather than proven.
